scope: virtual-device complete HCI/GATT through QEMU native HCI

terminal_signals.guest_reset: HCI Reset 01030c00 was sent again after the second ATT request

diagnostic_findings.partial_write_note: Temporary instrumentation showed all 73 malformed counters were non-final writes to the VHCI length field; valid full-length writes were still forwarded to Bumble.
diagnostic_findings.failure_boundary: The complete packet bytes reach Bumble, and C2H packets are delivered with status 0, but the host reset path is triggered after the second ATT request. The unresolved boundary is controller-response lifecycle and the vCPU safe point used to enter firmware callbacks.
rejected_fixes: pinning callbacks only to CPU0 left queued C2H packets undispatched while CPU0 was running
allowing callbacks at arbitrary CPU0 safe points caused BLE initialization timeout
removing RX drops without changing the callback transaction did not fix service discovery
